description: Ground truth for evaluating ERC-3643 + HKMA/SFC compliance performance across Phase 2 and Phase 3.

items.title: Token Contract Must Reference the Correct IdentityRegistry
items.rationale: Token.identityRegistry correctly points to the deployed IdentityRegistry contract.

items.title: IdentityRegistry Must Link Properly to the ClaimTopicsRegistry
items.rationale: IdentityRegistry.claimTopicsRegistry matches the expected ClaimTopicsRegistry instance.

items.title: Compliance Contract Must Be Bound and Linked Back to Token
items.rationale: Compliance contract is deployed, bound to token, and token.compliance() returns correct address.

items.title: Compliance Hooks Must Be Invoked in Token Operations
items.rationale: Transfer and mint/burn functions include canTransfer and onTransfer hooks.

items.title: ClaimTopicsRegistry Must Support Topic Management Functions
items.rationale: CTR exposes addClaimTopic(), removeClaimTopic(), and getClaimTopics() APIs as required by ERC-3643.

items.title: KYC Identity Verification Must Be Enforced Before Token Transfers
items.rationale: Transfers require verification in IdentityRegistry; satisfies HKMA AML/KYC standards.

items.title: Transaction Record-Keeping Must Meet HKMA AML Obligations
items.rationale: All investor identity changes and token transfers emit events for audit trails per HKMA AML Guideline §3.3.

items.title: Client Identity Verification Must Comply with SFC Code of Conduct §5.4
items.rationale: Registry requires full client identity prior to onboarding; aligns with SFC Code of Conduct §5.4.

items.title: Account Opening Procedures Must Follow SFC Approved Verification Methods
items.rationale: Investor registration relies on SFC-approved intermediaries or digital certification flows.

items.title: Client Identity Information Must Be Readily Available to Regulators on Request
items.rationale: RegistryStorage exposes read access for compliance officers; complies with SFC Circular on AML/CTF §3.5.
